Best horde-shooter to play right now with tons of content, the weapons feel amazing and satisfying to use, they can also be significantly changed through overclocks making the same gun support multiple play styles, 4 classes that are all equally useful and have very fun equipment and loadouts, a bar in the space rig to let you get drunk as much as your heart desires. based devs for having the most consumer friendly monetization system, the season passes are free to grind and each season brings loads of new content, you literally have to go out of your way to buy DLCs that are purely cosmetics, one of the few games where I personally felt buying cosmetics from the shop were worth it to support the devs. The devs push play to earn very heavily which I wholeheartedly support. Cave generations are beautiful and a huge roster of different enemy types to mercilessly show them what bullets are for. The music team absolutely outdid themselves with all soundtracks slapping hard. Game is definitely aimed towards playing coop but I still had an absolute blast playing solo, more than half my playtime was in solo missions and they balance it out by giving you the best clanka to exist bosco. This game is an absolute must play.
ROCK AND STONE

Deep Rock Galactic is peak dwarf nonsense. A workplace comedy where every shift involves explosives, yelling, and at least one bug trying to eat your beard. You mine like a professional, fight like a maniac, and party like the cave just paid you overtime. Every mission is a beautiful disaster powered by good times bravado, and the collective will to scream “ROCK AND STONE” louder than whatever’s trying to kill you.

I can't possibly recommend it enough or explain how much this game changed my life (not joking) I met so many great friends on this game, such a gem of a game and a community, it's just so PERFECT that I will keep playing even after +500 hours :)

my recommendation is TRY IT FOR YOURSELF start small with Solo missions then when you get hang of it, go online and enjoy playing with others
[ I also advise you to watch some tips and tricks on YouTube :) ]

AND REMEMBER!! always ROCK & STONE (press V) 
every time you hear someone ROCK & STONE
great game with very satisfying guns

It's been a long time since I have played this game, but since I want to now go and review the games I have played, I'll try to keep this brief.
[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
There are four classes to choose from, and I only ever played scout, as I loved his range of motion with the grappler and the gun he had was fairly good. Plus his flare gun was extremely useful to use as it was so much better than the regular flares everyone throws out. Can't say anything on the other classes, but it overall was fun trying to get as much ore as possible and killing bugs. It was also funny with all the dwarf voices and them interacting with one another(rock and stone, baby!).
[h2]Performance & Polish[/h2]
Not only is the game extremely optimized in terms of storage(I forgot how much it is, maybe 4GB total), but it also is optimized performance wise. I was able to run the game on high settings in 1080p and get a solid 240fps with occasional frame drops in environments with [i]more stuff[/i]. I believe I did use FSR for this but I feel like this game isn't too hard to run, except on a potato PC. I played this on my old custom desktop so I can't link specs here, but basically it was on a 9th gen Intel i9, an AMD RX6600, and 16GB DDR4.
[h2]Value[/h2]
For $30 there is a lot of replay value for a game like this. You can progress each class and of course there is the season passes for gear, cosmetics, and such. I didn't go over a whole lot but even though I don't play this much anymore, I feel I got my money's worth out of this game. I did play a lot with friends, so it really comes down to preference if you and your friends will consistently play, or if you're good going on your own(at least from time to time). If the game is on sale, all the better.
[h2]Verdict: Would recommend.[/h2]
